answers.question: why is the earth round
variants: why is earth shaped like a ball
answers.answer: Gravity pulls everything toward the middle, so big things like Earth squish into a ball shape. Round and cozy!

answers.question: how big is the earth
answers.answer: Earth is huge! Going all the way around it is about 25,000 miles. A car driving nonstop would take more than two weeks!

answers.question: why do we have day and night
variants: why does it get dark at night
where does the sun go at night
answers.answer: Earth spins like a top! When our side faces the sun, it's day. When it turns away, it's night.

answers.question: why is the sky blue
variants: how come the sky is blue
answers.answer: Sunlight has every color inside it. Air bounces the blue light all around the sky, so blue is what we see!

answers.question: how far away is the moon
variants: how far is it to the moon
answers.answer: The Moon is about 239,000 miles away. That's like going around the whole Earth almost 10 times!

answers.question: why does the moon change shape
variants: why does the moon look different
what are the phases of the moon
answers.answer: The Moon doesn't really change. As it circles Earth each month, we see different amounts of its sunny side.

answers.question: what is the sun
variants: what is the sun made of
answers.answer: The Sun is a star, a giant ball of super hot gas. It's so big that about a million Earths could fit inside!

answers.question: how hot is the sun
variants: how hot is it on the sun
answers.answer: The Sun's surface is about 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, way hotter than any oven! That's why we never look right at it.

answers.question: what are stars
answers.answer: Stars are giant balls of glowing gas, like our Sun. They look tiny because they are very, very far away.

answers.question: how many stars are there
variants: how many stars are in the sky
how many stars are in space
answers.answer: More than anyone can count! Our galaxy alone has billions and billions of stars. On a dark night you can see thousands.

answers.question: what is a galaxy
variants: what galaxy do we live in
answers.answer: A galaxy is a giant family of stars. We live in one called the Milky Way. It's shaped like a big swirl!

answers.question: what is gravity
variants: why don't we fall off the earth
answers.answer: Gravity is an invisible pull. Earth pulls on you all the time, which keeps your feet on the ground. No floating away!

answers.question: what is the universe
answers.answer: The universe is everything there is: all the stars, planets, moons and space itself. It's bigger than anyone can imagine!

answers.question: what is an astronaut
variants: how do you become an astronaut
answers.answer: An astronaut is a person who travels into space. They train for years and wear special suits to breathe up there!

answers.question: how big is africa
answers.answer: Africa is the second biggest continent! The USA, China and India could all fit inside it, with room to spare.

answers.question: how many countries are in africa
variants: how many countries does africa have
answers.answer: Africa has 54 countries! That's more than any other continent.

answers.question: what is the sahara
variants: what is the biggest desert in africa
how big is the sahara desert
answers.answer: The Sahara is the biggest hot desert in the world. It's almost as big as the whole United States!

answers.question: what is the longest river in africa
variants: what is the longest river in the world
answers.answer: The Nile! It's one of the longest rivers in the world, flowing about 4,100 miles north to the sea.

answers.question: what is the tallest mountain in africa
variants: what is the biggest mountain in africa
answers.answer: Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania! It's so tall it has snow on top, even though it's close to the equator.

answers.question: what animals live in africa
answers.answer: Lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, hippos, rhinos, cheetahs and gorillas! Africa has some of the most amazing animals on Earth.

answers.question: is africa hot
variants: is it always hot in africa
answers.answer: Lots of Africa is warm, but not all of it! There are snowy mountain tops, cool highlands and chilly desert nights.

answers.question: is there a rainforest in africa
answers.answer: Africa has a giant rainforest by the Congo River. It's home to gorillas, chimps and forest elephants!

answers.question: what languages do people speak in africa
variants: what language do they speak in africa
how many languages are in africa
answers.answer: Africa has well over a thousand languages! People speak Swahili, Arabic, Zulu, Amharic, French, English and many more.

answers.question: what is the biggest land animal
variants: what is the biggest animal in africa
how big is an african elephant
answers.answer: The African elephant! It's the biggest animal on land and can be heavier than three cars put together.

answers.question: what is victoria falls
variants: what is the biggest waterfall in africa
answers.answer: Victoria Falls is a giant waterfall between Zambia and Zimbabwe. Its mist rises so high, people call it the smoke that thunders!

answers.question: where do lemurs live
answers.answer: Lemurs live on Madagascar, a big island near Africa. It's the only place in the wild where they're found!

answers.question: what is a savannah
variants: what does a savannah look like
answers.answer: A savannah is a big, grassy land with a few trees here and there. It's warm, and lots of animals roam it!

answers.question: why do zebras have stripes
answers.answer: Scientists think stripes help keep biting flies away and may help zebras stay cool. And every zebra's stripes are different!

answers.question: why do giraffes have long necks
variants: why is a giraffe neck so long
answers.answer: A long neck lets a giraffe eat leaves high in the trees, where other animals can't reach. Yum!

answers.question: how tall is a giraffe
answers.answer: A grown-up giraffe can be about 18 feet tall. That's taller than a one-story house!

answers.question: why do lions roar
variants: how loud is a lion roar
answers.answer: Lions roar to tell other lions, this is our home! A roar can be heard about 5 miles away.

answers.question: how fast is a cheetah
variants: how fast can a cheetah run
answers.answer: Cheetahs are the fastest runners on land! For a short sprint they can go about 70 miles an hour, as fast as a car on the highway.

answers.question: why do elephants have trunks
variants: what do elephants use their trunks for
what is an elephant trunk for
answers.answer: An elephant's trunk is a nose and a hand! It uses it to smell, grab food, drink water and even give hugs.

answers.question: why do elephants have big ears
variants: why are elephant ears so big
why do elephants flap their ears
answers.answer: African elephants flap their big ears to cool off. Blood in the ears cools down, like a built-in fan!

answers.question: what do lions eat
answers.answer: Lions are meat eaters. They mostly eat big grass-eating animals like zebras and wildebeest.

answers.question: what do giraffes eat
answers.answer: Giraffes love leaves, especially from acacia trees. Their long tongues can grab leaves right past the thorns!

answers.question: what is a watering hole
variants: why do animals go to the watering hole
why do animals drink at the watering hole
answers.answer: A watering hole is a pond where animals come to drink. In the dry season, it's the busiest spot on the savannah!

answers.question: why do hippos stay in the water
variants: why do hippos live in water
why are hippos in the water
answers.answer: Hippos spend the day in water to stay cool and keep their skin from drying in the sun. At night they come out to eat grass.

answers.question: what is a baobab tree
variants: why is the baobab tree so fat
answers.answer: A baobab is a giant tree with a super thick trunk. It can store lots of water inside to get through dry times!

answers.question: what does a wildlife ranger do
answers.answer: Rangers protect animals and their homes. They watch over them, help hurt animals get better, and keep the land safe.

answers.question: what are the pyramids
variants: why did they build the pyramids
answers.answer: The pyramids are giant stone buildings made long ago in Egypt. Many were built as tombs for kings called pharaohs.

answers.question: how big is the great pyramid
variants: how tall is the great pyramid
how many blocks are in the great pyramid
answers.answer: The Great Pyramid was the tallest building in the world for over 3,800 years! It's made of more than 2 million stone blocks.

answers.question: what is a pharaoh
answers.answer: A pharaoh was a king of ancient Egypt. The pharaoh was the most important ruler in the land.

answers.question: what is the nile river
answers.answer: The Nile is a long river that runs through Egypt. Its water helped farmers grow food right next to the desert!

answers.question: who was moses
variants: who was moses in the bible
answers.answer: In the Bible, Moses was a Hebrew baby saved in a basket on the Nile. He grew up to lead God's people out of Egypt.

answers.question: why was baby moses in a basket
variants: why was moses in a basket
answers.answer: His mother hid him in a little basket boat on the Nile to keep him safe. Pharaoh's daughter found him and raised him.

answers.question: what were the ten plagues
variants: what are the plagues of egypt
answers.answer: In the Bible, God sent ten plagues on Egypt, like frogs, flies and darkness, so Pharaoh would let His people go free.

answers.question: how did moses cross the red sea
variants: how did they cross the red sea
what happened at the red sea
answers.answer: The Bible says God parted the Red Sea, making a dry path between walls of water, and His people walked safely across!

answers.question: who was joseph in egypt
variants: who was joseph in the bible
answers.answer: In the Bible, Joseph was sold by his brothers, but God was with him. He became a leader in Egypt and saved many from hunger.

answers.question: what was joseph's coat
variants: what was joseph's coat of many colors
why did joseph have a special coat
answers.answer: Joseph's father Jacob gave him a special coat. Many Bibles call it a coat of many colors!

answers.question: how did joseph save egypt
variants: what did joseph do for pharaoh
answers.answer: God helped Joseph explain Pharaoh's dreams. Egypt saved grain in seven good years, so there was food in seven hungry years.

answers.question: did jesus live in egypt
answers.answer: Yes! The Bible says Mary and Joseph took baby Jesus to Egypt to keep Him safe, and later they went back home.

answers.question: what are hieroglyphs
answers.answer: Hieroglyphs are ancient Egyptian writing made of little pictures. Some pictures stood for sounds, like our letters!

answers.question: why do camels have humps
variants: what is in a camel hump
do camels store water in their humps
answers.answer: A camel's hump stores fat, not water! The fat gives it energy for long desert walks without food.

answers.question: what is a shaduf
answers.answer: A shaduf is a long pole with a bucket on one end and a weight on the other. Egyptians used it to lift river water to their fields.

answers.question: why is the arctic cold
variants: why is it so cold in the arctic
why is the north pole cold
answers.answer: The Arctic is at the top of the world, so sunlight hits it at a low slant and spreads thin. That keeps it icy cold!

answers.question: what do polar bears eat
variants: what does a polar bear eat
what food do polar bears eat
answers.answer: Polar bears mostly eat seals. They wait by holes in the sea ice where seals come up to breathe.

answers.question: why are polar bears white
variants: why is a polar bear white
what color is a polar bear
answers.answer: Polar bear fur looks white, which helps them hide in the snow. Under the fur, their skin is actually black!

answers.question: how do polar bears stay warm
variants: why don't polar bears get cold
how does a polar bear stay warm
answers.answer: Polar bears have thick fur and a layer of fat called blubber. It's like wearing a cozy coat all the time!

answers.question: do penguins live in the arctic
variants: are there penguins in the arctic
answers.answer: Nope! Wild penguins live in the southern half of the world, like Antarctica. The Arctic has polar bears, seals and walruses.

answers.question: what is an igloo
variants: how do you build an igloo
why is it warm in an igloo
answers.answer: An igloo is a dome made of snow blocks. Snow traps air, so inside it's much warmer than the wind outside!

answers.question: what are the northern lights
variants: why does the sky glow green
answers.answer: The northern lights are glowing ribbons of green and pink in the sky. They happen when tiny bits from the Sun hit our air.

answers.question: does the sun set in the arctic
variants: why is it light all night in the arctic
is it dark all winter in the arctic
answers.answer: In Arctic summer, the Sun can stay up all night! In winter it can stay down for weeks. Days and nights get really long there.

answers.question: why do walruses have tusks
variants: what do walruses use their tusks for
answers.answer: Walruses use their long tusks to pull themselves out of the water onto the ice. Their whiskers help them find clams!

answers.question: what is an arctic fox
variants: what color is an arctic fox
answers.answer: Arctic foxes have fur that turns white in winter and brown in summer, so they can hide all year long!

answers.question: do people live in the arctic
variants: what people live in the arctic
answers.answer: Yes! People like the Inuit have lived in the Arctic for thousands of years, fishing, hunting and traveling by sled.

answers.question: what is a husky
answers.answer: Huskies are strong, fluffy dogs that love to run in the snow. A team of them can pull a sled a long way!

answers.question: what is ice fishing
variants: how do you fish through ice
answers.answer: In ice fishing, people cut a small hole in the frozen water and drop a line in. The fish swim below the ice!

answers.question: what is an iceberg
answers.answer: An iceberg is a giant chunk of ice floating in the sea. Most of it hides under the water. Only the tip pokes out!

answers.question: what is a coral reef
answers.answer: Coral looks like a plant or a rock, but it's made of tiny animals! Together they build reefs where lots of fish live.

answers.question: how big is the great barrier reef
variants: what is the great barrier reef
what is the biggest coral reef
answers.answer: The Great Barrier Reef near Australia is the biggest coral reef in the world. It's so big, astronauts can see it from space!

answers.question: why do so many fish live on the reef
variants: why do fish live in the reef
why are there lots of fish on the reef
answers.answer: Reefs are full of nooks to hide in and lots of food to eat. That makes them busy, colorful fish neighborhoods!

answers.question: where do clownfish live
variants: why do clownfish live in anemones
answers.answer: Clownfish live in sea anemones. The anemone's sting doesn't hurt them, so it keeps them safe from bigger fish!

answers.question: how do fish breathe
variants: how do fish breathe in water
answers.answer: Fish breathe with gills! Gills pull oxygen out of the water as it flows over them.

answers.question: do sharks sleep
answers.answer: Sharks rest, but some must keep swimming to push water over their gills. Others can lie still on the sea floor.

answers.question: how many teeth does a shark have
variants: how many teeth do sharks have
answers.answer: Sharks lose old teeth and grow new ones all their lives! Some sharks go through thousands of teeth.

answers.question: how long do sea turtles live
variants: where do sea turtles lay eggs
answers.answer: Sea turtles swim the oceans for many years, and some live 50 years or more! Mama turtles come to the beach to lay eggs.

answers.question: how many arms does an octopus have
variants: how many hearts does an octopus have
answers.answer: An octopus has eight arms and three hearts! It can change color and squeeze through tiny spaces.

answers.question: why is trash bad for the reef
variants: why should we pick up trash in the ocean
is plastic bad for the ocean
answers.answer: Trash can hurt sea animals. A turtle may think a plastic bag is a jellyfish and eat it. Picking up trash keeps the reef healthy!

answers.question: what is a jellyfish
answers.answer: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones! They float along, and some can even glow in the dark.

answers.question: is a starfish a fish
variants: can a starfish regrow an arm
answers.answer: Sea stars, or starfish, aren't really fish. Most have five arms, and if one arm is lost, it can grow back!

answers.question: why is coral colorful
answers.answer: Tiny helpers called algae live inside coral and give it bright colors. They also make food for the coral!

answers.question: what is north america
variants: what countries are in north america
answers.answer: North America is the continent with Canada, the United States, Mexico and more. It stretches from the icy Arctic to warm beaches!

answers.question: what is the biggest country in north america
variants: is canada bigger than the united states
answers.answer: Canada is the biggest country in North America. It's the second biggest country in the whole world!

answers.question: what is the tallest mountain in north america
variants: what is the biggest mountain in north america
answers.answer: Denali in Alaska is the tallest mountain in North America. It's more than 20,000 feet high!

answers.question: what is the grand canyon
variants: how deep is the grand canyon
how was the grand canyon made
answers.answer: The Grand Canyon is a giant canyon in Arizona, carved by the Colorado River. In places it's more than a mile deep!

answers.question: what animals live in north america
variants: what animals are in north america
which animals live in north america
answers.answer: Bears, moose, bald eagles, bison, wolves, raccoons and even alligators! North America has lots of amazing animals.

answers.question: what is a bald eagle
variants: is a bald eagle really bald
why is it called a bald eagle
answers.answer: The bald eagle is a big bird with a white head. It isn't really bald! It's a symbol of the United States.

answers.question: what are the great lakes
variants: how many great lakes are there
how big are the great lakes
answers.answer: The Great Lakes are five huge lakes between the USA and Canada. They're so big they look like oceans!

answers.question: what is the longest river in north america
variants: how long is the mississippi river
answers.answer: The Missouri and Mississippi rivers together make the longest river system in North America, flowing all the way to the Gulf.

answers.question: what is niagara falls
answers.answer: Niagara Falls is a set of giant waterfalls between the USA and Canada. Tons and tons of water pour over it every second!

answers.question: what is a bison
answers.answer: Bison are big, shaggy animals that roam the plains. They're the heaviest land animals in North America!

answers.question: what is a moose
answers.answer: A moose is the biggest kind of deer! Males grow huge antlers, and moose are great swimmers too.

answers.question: what is australia
variants: is australia a country or a continent
answers.answer: Australia is both! It's a country and a continent, and it's surrounded by ocean.

answers.question: why do kangaroos hop
variants: how far can a kangaroo jump
answers.answer: Kangaroos hop on big, strong back legs. Hopping lets them travel far without getting tired!

answers.question: what is a joey
variants: what is in a kangaroo pouch
answers.answer: A baby kangaroo is called a joey. It lives in mom's pouch, safe and warm, until it's big enough to hop around.

answers.question: what is a koala
answers.answer: Koalas munch eucalyptus leaves and sleep up to 20 hours a day! They aren't bears. They're marsupials, like kangaroos.

answers.question: what is a platypus
variants: what does a platypus look like
answers.answer: A platypus has a duck-like bill and a beaver-like tail, and it lays eggs, even though it's a mammal. What a surprise!

answers.question: what is the outback
answers.answer: The outback is the big, dry middle of Australia. It has red dirt, few people, and animals like kangaroos and emus.

answers.question: what is an emu
answers.answer: An emu is a giant bird that can't fly, but it can run super fast! It's one of the tallest birds in the world.

answers.question: why are the seasons opposite in australia
variants: is christmas in summer in australia
is it summer in australia now
answers.answer: Australia is in the southern half of the world. When it's winter in the USA, it's summer there. Christmas at the beach!

answers.question: what is the sydney opera house
variants: what is the building that looks like sails
answers.answer: The Sydney Opera House is a famous building in Australia. Its roof looks like giant white sails by the water!

answers.question: what is a wombat
answers.answer: Wombats are chubby, furry diggers that live in burrows. Fun fact: their poop is shaped like little cubes!

answers.question: what is uluru
variants: what is the big red rock in australia
answers.answer: Uluru is a giant red rock in the middle of Australia. It's very special to the Aboriginal people, who have lived there a long time.

answers.question: what is a kookaburra
answers.answer: A kookaburra is an Australian bird whose call sounds like loud, happy laughing!

answers.question: how many continents are there
answers.answer: There are seven continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia, Europe, North America and South America!

answers.question: what is the biggest continent
answers.answer: Asia is the biggest continent. It has the most people, too!

answers.question: what is the smallest continent
answers.answer: Australia is the smallest continent, but it's still really big!

answers.question: what is antarctica
answers.answer: Antarctica is the icy continent at the bottom of the world. It's the coldest place on Earth, and penguins live there!

answers.question: what is the tallest mountain in the world
answers.answer: Mount Everest in Asia is the tallest mountain on Earth, about 29,000 feet high. That's more than 5 miles up!

answers.question: what is the amazon rainforest
variants: what lives in the amazon rainforest
answers.answer: The Amazon in South America is the biggest rainforest in the world. It's home to jaguars, sloths, toucans and more!

answers.question: what is the amazon river
variants: how big is the amazon river
which river has the most water
answers.answer: The Amazon River in South America carries more water than any other river on Earth!

answers.question: what is a sloth
answers.answer: Sloths live in rainforests in Central and South America. They move so slowly that tiny plants can grow on their fur!

answers.question: what is europe
answers.answer: Europe is a continent with lots of countries close together, like France, Italy, Spain and Germany. It has many old castles!

answers.question: what is the great wall of china
variants: how long is the great wall of china
why was the great wall built
answers.answer: The Great Wall of China was built in Asia long ago to protect the land. It stretches for thousands of miles!

answers.question: where do pandas live
answers.answer: Giant pandas live in the mountains of China. They munch bamboo for many hours every day!

answers.question: what is the biggest country in the world
answers.answer: Russia is the biggest country in the world. It's in both Europe and Asia!

answers.question: where do tigers live
answers.answer: Tigers are the biggest wild cats. They live in Asia, and every tiger has its own stripe pattern!

answers.question: who are you
answers.answer: I'm Spark, your explorer friend! I help you find fun places, give hints, and share cool facts about our world.

answers.question: what can you do
answers.answer: I can show you places to explore, give hints when you're stuck, and answer questions about animals, space and more!

answers.question: what is your favorite animal
variants: do you have a favorite animal
what animal do you like best
answers.answer: I love them all, but giraffes are extra fun. They're so tall they could peek in an upstairs window!

answers.question: what is your favorite color
variants: do you have a favorite color
answers.answer: I like gold, the color of my sparkle! But a rainbow has every color, and that's pretty great too.

answers.question: why is the ocean salty
answers.answer: Rivers carry tiny bits of salt from rocks into the ocean. Water floats up into clouds, but the salt stays behind!

answers.question: how deep is the ocean
variants: what is the deepest part of the ocean
answers.answer: The deepest spot, the Mariana Trench, is almost 7 miles down. Mount Everest could fit inside with room to spare!

answers.question: how many oceans are there
answers.answer: There are five oceans: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic. The Pacific is the biggest!

answers.question: what is the biggest animal
variants: what is the biggest animal in the world
how big is a blue whale
answers.answer: The blue whale is the biggest animal ever! It's longer than a basketball court.

answers.question: is a whale a fish
answers.answer: Whales aren't fish, they're mammals like us! They swim up to breathe air through a blowhole on top of their head.

answers.question: how do dolphins talk
answers.answer: Dolphins talk with clicks and whistles. Each dolphin even has its own special whistle, kind of like a name!

answers.question: what is the fastest animal
variants: what is the fastest animal in the world
answers.answer: The peregrine falcon! When it dives, it can go over 200 miles an hour. The cheetah is the fastest runner on land.

answers.question: what is the tallest animal
variants: what is the tallest animal in the world
answers.answer: The giraffe is the tallest animal on Earth. A big one is about as tall as three grown-ups stacked up!

answers.question: why do cats purr
variants: what does it mean when a cat purrs
answers.answer: Cats often purr when they feel happy and cozy. Sometimes they purr to calm themselves down, too.

answers.question: why do dogs wag their tails
variants: why does my dog wag its tail
what does a tail wag mean
answers.answer: Dogs wag their tails to show feelings. A big, loose wag usually means happy and excited to see you!

answers.question: how do birds fly
answers.answer: Birds have light, hollow bones and strong wings. Flapping pushes air down, which lifts them up into the sky!

answers.question: how do bees make honey
answers.answer: Bees sip sweet nectar from flowers and store it in wax cells. As the water dries out, it turns into honey!

answers.question: how does a caterpillar turn into a butterfly
variants: why do caterpillars turn into butterflies
answers.answer: A caterpillar eats and grows, then makes a chrysalis. Inside, it changes, and out comes a butterfly!

answers.question: what is a mammal
variants: what makes an animal a mammal
answers.answer: Mammals have hair or fur, breathe air, and feed their babies milk. Dogs, whales, elephants and people are all mammals!

answers.question: why does it rain
answers.answer: The sun warms water so it floats up and makes clouds. When clouds get full and heavy, drops fall down as rain!

answers.question: what makes a rainbow
variants: what colors are in a rainbow
answers.answer: Sunlight shining through raindrops splits into colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet!

answers.question: what is thunder
variants: why is there thunder and lightning
answers.answer: Lightning is a giant spark in the sky. It heats the air so fast that the air goes BOOM, and that's thunder!

answers.question: why does it snow
answers.answer: When it's very cold up in the clouds, water freezes into tiny ice crystals. They stick together and float down as snowflakes!

answers.question: what is a tornado
answers.answer: A tornado is a spinning tube of wind that reaches from a storm cloud to the ground. Grown-ups watch the weather to keep everyone safe.

answers.question: what is wind
answers.answer: Wind is moving air! The sun warms some places more than others, and air rushes around to even things out.

answers.question: how many planets are there
variants: how many planets are in the solar system
answers.answer: There are eight planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune!

answers.question: what is the biggest planet
answers.answer: Jupiter is the biggest planet. More than 1,000 Earths could fit inside it!

answers.question: what is the hottest planet
answers.answer: Venus is the hottest planet, even hotter than Mercury! Its thick clouds trap heat like a big blanket.

answers.question: why is mars red
variants: why is mars called the red planet
answers.answer: Mars is covered in rusty dust, kind of like an old rusty bike. That makes it look red!

answers.question: what are saturn's rings made of
answers.answer: Saturn's rings are made of billions of chunks of ice and rock. Some are as small as sand, and some are as big as houses!

answers.question: what is the smallest planet
answers.answer: Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun. It's just a little bigger than our Moon!

answers.question: can people live on mars
answers.answer: Not yet! Mars is cold, with thin air we can't breathe. Scientists are working on ways people might visit someday.

answers.question: what is a black hole
variants: what happens in a black hole
answers.answer: A black hole is a place in space where gravity pulls so hard that not even light can get out!

answers.question: who was the first person on the moon
variants: who walked on the moon first
has anyone been to the moon
answers.answer: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon, in 1969. He called it one small step!

answers.question: how far away is the sun
variants: how far is the sun from earth
answers.answer: The Sun is about 93 million miles away. Even light, the fastest thing there is, takes about 8 minutes to get here!

answers.question: what was the biggest dinosaur
answers.answer: Some of the biggest were long-necked dinosaurs like Argentinosaurus. They were longer than three school buses!

answers.question: what is a t rex
variants: how big was a t rex
answers.answer: T. rex was a giant meat-eating dinosaur with big, strong teeth and tiny arms. It was about as long as a school bus!

answers.question: what happened to the dinosaurs
answers.answer: Most scientists think a giant space rock hit Earth long ago and changed the weather. Birds are cousins of the dinosaurs!

answers.question: how do we know about dinosaurs
variants: how do scientists find dinosaur bones
answers.answer: We learn from fossils! Bones, teeth and footprints turned to stone, and scientists dig them up like a giant puzzle.

answers.question: what is the biggest tree
variants: how big is a sequoia tree
answers.answer: Giant sequoias and redwoods in California are the biggest trees on Earth. Some are taller than a 25-story building!

answers.question: what is the tallest building
variants: what is the tallest building in the world
how tall is the burj khalifa
answers.answer: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the tallest building. It's over half a mile high, with more than 160 floors!

answers.question: how long is a mile
answers.answer: A mile is about 20 minutes of walking for a grown-up, or 4 laps around a running track!

answers.question: what is the coldest place on earth
variants: what is the coldest place in the world
answers.answer: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth. It can get colder than 100 degrees below zero!

answers.question: why do leaves change color
variants: why do leaves fall in autumn
answers.answer: In fall, trees stop making green chlorophyll. The green fades, and the yellow and orange that were hiding show up!

answers.question: why do we need sleep
variants: why do we have to sleep
answers.answer: Sleep helps your body grow and your brain sort out everything you learned. Explorers need good rest!

answers.question: why do we brush our teeth
variants: why do i have to brush my teeth
why should i brush my teeth
answers.answer: Brushing sweeps away tiny germs that love sugar and can make holes in teeth. Two minutes, twice a day!

answers.question: what is a volcano
answers.answer: A volcano is a mountain with an opening that lets out super hot melted rock, called lava, from deep inside the Earth.

answers.question: what is an earthquake
answers.answer: An earthquake is when big pieces of the Earth's crust slip and shake the ground. Grown-ups know how to keep you safe.
